description: A React component implementing the login page for Mattermost, handling user authentication, external OAuth logins, session management, and UI rendering.

methods.name: getExternalLoginOptions
methods.description: Generates OAuth login options based on configuration flags, including handling for external providers like GitLab, Google, Office365, OpenID, and SAML.

methods.name: handleExternalAuth
methods.description: Handles external OAuth login button clicks, managing desktop app redirection, embedded view messaging, and navigation.

methods.name: dismissAlert
methods.description: Clears alert banners and error states.

methods.name: onDismissSessionExpired
methods.description: Handles dismissal of session expired notifications, resetting relevant states.

methods.name: configureTitle
methods.description: Sets the document title based on session state and site name.

methods.name: showSessionExpiredNotificationIfNeeded
methods.description: Displays desktop or browser notifications when the session has expired.

methods.name: getAlertData
methods.description: Prepares alert banner data based on session and URL parameters.

methods.name: getAlternateLink
methods.description: Returns the alternate link component for sign-up or access problem pages.

methods.name: preSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, validating inputs, managing login flow, and error handling.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Performs login dispatch, handles errors, and proceeds with post-login actions.

methods.name: checkUserLoginType
methods.description: Checks if the user login is via magic link or deactivated, adjusting login flow accordingly.

methods.name: postSubmit
methods.description: Loads user data after login, handles invite acceptance, and redirects appropriately.

methods.name: finishSignin
methods.description: Completes sign-in process, updates local storage, and redirects to appropriate page.

methods.name: handleHeaderBackButtonOnClick
methods.description: Handles back button click in MFA flow, resetting MFA state.

methods.name: handleInputOnChange
methods.description: Updates login ID state and resets errors on input change.

methods.name: handlePasswordInputOnChange
methods.description: Updates password state and resets errors on input change.

methods.name: handleBrandImageError
methods.description: Handles error in brand image loading, falling back to default branding.

methods.name: getCardTitle
methods.description: Determines the login card title based on custom branding and sign-in methods.

methods.name: getMessageSubtitle
methods.description: Returns the subtitle message component, supporting custom branding.

methods.name: getResetPasswordLink
methods.description: Provides the 'Forgot password' link if enabled and applicable.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Renders the main login content, including MFA, redirect handling, and login forms.
